name: AUTOPILOT.OI Refund Agent
description_html:
Get your money back: flights, double charges, missing orders.

A Claude agent that finds possible refunds on your statements, works out which rule or policy likely applies and what to confirm, drafts a short request that names it, writes the next step if they say no, and tracks every deadline.

What you get (12 page agent pack, PDF): a setup builder that installs the agent with you, setup questions, full agent instructions, the worked example from our reel, templates and a tracker.

How it works: it runs inside a Claude Project. It finds, checks and drafts; you send. It does not contact companies or file disputes on its own, and it does not guess laws or deadlines.

You need: a Claude account (the free plan works) and your receipts, bookings or statements.

Education only, not legal or financial advice. AUTOPILOT.OI is independent and not affiliated with Anthropic.
